initialization: original SDAR-8B-Chat; no SFT and no LoRA

execution.walltime_recovery: resume only after a complete online iteration
execution.completed_iteration_contract: model shard index and every referenced shard plus multitrace receipt; DCoLT additionally requires dcolt_upm.pt
execution.partial_iteration_contract: fail closed; archive the partial iteration with provenance and recompute that iteration
execution.evaluation_recovery: reuse complete deterministic evaluation shards and recompute only missing shards

neda.credit: A_i/H_i times a conservative mixture of uniform and normalized executed-Action log-probability evidence over denoising steps

mapg.position_policy: Plackett-Luce over maximum SDAR vocabulary logits
mapg.clipping: separate token and position GSPO-style ratios

dcolt.clipping: joint token plus UPM position trajectory ratio
